The answer perfectly explains and mathematically defines the late-interaction operator using the maximum dot product between query and document token embeddings.

rows.answer:
ColPali's late-interaction operator $\text{LI}(q,d)$ is computed as the sum over all query vectors $\mathbf{E}_q^{(i)}$ of their maximum dot product with the document embedding vectors $\mathbf{E}_d^{(j)}$. Mathematically, it is defined as:

$$\text{LI}(q, d) = \sum_{i \in [1, N_q]} \max_{j \in [1, N_d]} \langle \mathbf{E}_q^{(i)} | \mathbf{E}_d^{(j)} \rangle$$
